run.question: Search the 'app-183c-logs' index for ERROR level log messages. What error codes (format ERR-XXXX) appear in the logs?

report.summary: The Elasticsearch index app-183c-logs (1 index matched, health green, 7 documents) contains three documents at level ERROR inside the authorized window (time filter on the mapped date field timestamp, 2026-10-24T17:12:21Z to 2026-11-23T17:12:21Z). The error codes in those ERROR messages are ERR-7291, ERR-4058 and ERR-9463. Each appears once: ERR-7291 in a Database connection timeout message from service payment-api at 2026-11-23T16:51:00Z; ERR-4058 in a Payment validation failed / Invalid card number format message from service order-service at 2026-11-23T16:56:00Z; ERR-9463 in a Stock sync failed / external inventory API returned 503 message from service inventory-api at 2026-11-23T17:06:00Z. A full listing of all 7 documents in the index over the same window returned those same three ERROR rows plus four non-error rows (two INFO and one WARN from payment-api, one INFO from order-service, one INFO from inventory-api), and the ERROR term query's total was exactly 3, so no additional ERROR-level code was observed in this index. This is a log content lookup only; no root cause was determined and no fault was diagnosed.

claims.text: Index app-183c-logs matched with health green, status open, docs.count 7, store.size 7.4kb; its mappings define fields error_code (keyword), level (keyword), message (text), service (keyword) and timestamp (date), and no @timestamp field.

A term query on level=ERROR over the whole authorized window (time_field timestamp, no shard failures, total relation eq value 3) returned exactly 3 ERROR documents: ERR-7291 (payment-api, 'Database connection timeout - ERR-7291: Failed to connect to primary database after 30s', 2026-11-23T16:51:00Z), ERR-4058 (order-service, 'Payment validation failed - ERR-4058: Invalid card number format', 2026-11-23T16:56:00Z), and ERR-9463 (inventory-api, 'Stock sync failed - ERR-9463: External inventory API returned 503', 2026-11-23T17:06:00Z).

The same window queried without a level filter returned all 7 documents (total eq 7) with timestamps from 2026-11-23T16:46:00Z to 2026-11-23T17:11:00Z: ERROR rows carrying ERR-7291, ERR-4058 and ERR-9463, plus non-error rows at level INFO (payment-api 16:46:00Z, order-service 17:01:00Z, inventory-api 17:11:00Z) and level WARN (payment-api 16:52:00Z), confirming the three ERROR codes are the complete set present in this index.

An earlier default-window query (time filter 2026-11-23T16:12:21Z to 2026-11-23T17:12:21Z) also returned the same 3 ERROR documents with error_code ERR-7291, ERR-4058 and ERR-9463, so the codes are consistent under both the default one-hour window and the full authorized window.

gaps: The ERROR lookup rests on a small index: 7 stored documents, all timestamped 2026-11-23T16:46:00Z to 2026-11-23T17:11:00Z. Whether other ERROR codes were logged earlier in the authorized window (2026-10-24T17:12:21Z to 2026-11-23T16:46:00Z) cannot be established from these documents; retention and ingest gaps are unknown.
No change-history integration is configured in this Run, so whether any change produced these error logs could not be checked (missing integration is not evidence of health or fault).
The four non-error documents were read only at level/service/timestamp granularity, so their message text and any additional detail in them were not examined.
next_steps: If these codes are to be tied to a service incident, correlate the three ERROR rows (payment-api 16:51:00Z, order-service 16:56:00Z, inventory-api 17:06:00Z) against traces and metrics for those services in the same window, since this task only asked for the log codes.
